title: Three Siblings in 1950s Suburban Neighborhood, Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: Three smiling siblings—two girls and a younger boy—pose together along the edge of a front lawn and driveway in a quintessential post-war American suburban development. The older girl wears a black short-sleeved top with a printed tiered skirt, the middle girl wears a white blouse with matching suspender straps and skirt, and the boy is dressed in a plaid button-up shirt with suspenders. In the background across the wide street stand modern mid-century single-story ranch houses outfitted with rooftop television aerials and a classic early-1950s sedan parked in a driveway. The photographer's silhouette is cast on the concrete in the foreground.
